definitions.gloss: missed delivery notice; delivery attempt slip
definitions.explanation: A notice left by a delivery person when a package cannot be delivered because no one is home.

examples.japanese: {不在票|ふざいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was a missed delivery notice.

examples.japanese: {不在票|ふざいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{再配達|さいはいたつ}→再配達：09690_saihaitatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I saw the missed delivery notice and requested redelivery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け→郵便受け：04889_yuubinuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不在票|ふざいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}→営業所：23605_eigyousho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}した→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: There was a missed delivery notice in the mailbox, so I contacted the delivery office.

notes:
{不在票|ふざいひょう} is the slip left by delivery services when a package cannot be delivered.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a missed delivery notice is left)
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check the missed delivery notice)

USAGE:
- Contains information for arranging redelivery
- Usually includes a QR code or phone number

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{再配達|さいはいたつ}→再配達：09690_saihaitatsu⟧: redelivery
- ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧: home delivery service
